summary: Link fresh trusted CI reruns to authenticated degraded predecessors and measure re-attestation time

replay.detail: No daemon replay change; identical CI selectors retain their original record and tier.

schema.detail: Uses the existing portable v1 re_attests field and adds no daemon claim fields.

rules.detail: No daemon rule, risk deadline or main landing change.

compatibility.detail: The protected observe-ci command gains immutable predecessor selectors and explicit re-attestation metrics. Existing calls without selectors keep their behavior.

manual.detail: Controllers may supply degraded record IDs only when requesting a fresh keyed rerun; the adapter independently fetches and authenticates old jobs.

recovery.detail: Signing outage leaves the fresh record degraded and unlinked; returning signing availability cannot promote that job. New Full re-attestation requires another fresh run or attempt.
